complete_examples.text: At this point, the maximum Z-vibration level are 59.5 dB, 57.4 dB and 53.8 dB, respectively, while the corresponding maximum acceleration values are 11.07 mm/s2, 8.49 mm/s2 and 4.78 mm/s2, respectively.

The figure demonstrates that the distributions of maximum accel eration and vibration level of the soil exhibit similar patterns for different soil elastic modulus conditions, with both are maximum at 10 m from the centerline of the track.
